title: RNA Extraction from 10µL Mouse Blood Samples Using KingFisher Flex
author: Petra Schneider
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.88fhztn
materials: Freeze samples at -70°C or immediately extract RNA.

Prepare reagents in kit only if opening a new MagMAX-96 Total RNA Isolation Kit (Cat#AM1830), Add the appropriate amount of ethanol or isopropanol to the wash buffers (see table below) and mark the bottles clearly by crossing out the word “concentrate”, ticking the small checkbox and writing your name/initials and the date. Note: some of the bench-top reagents crystallise when the ambient temperature is low (below ~18°C). To combat this, set a heat block to 25°C before beginning and place the room temperature reagents on it until ready to use, remembering to mix well!
Open the BindIt software . Select ‘Your Kingfisher Machine’ from the drop-down ‘connect’ list to connect to your Kingfisher instrument ( note: connection has likely established automatically) .

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tubes
steps.instruction: Dispense 20 µL of RNAlater into 0.2 mL strip tubes or 96-well plates (one well per sample). Cover tubes with lids or plates with thick plastic film (do not use optical qPCR film).

steps.title: Collect Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Take a 10 µL blood sample using glass capillaries and dispense immediately into the RNAlater for all samples.

steps.title: Mix Samples
steps.instruction: Mix the blood and RNAlater using a pipette or by carefully tapping the tube, then replace the lid.

steps.title: Gather Required Plastics
steps.instruction: Collect the following materials: 6 Kingfisher DeepWell (DW; Cat# 95040460) plates, 2 Kingfisher 96 (KF; Cat# 97002540) plates, and 1 DW tip comb (Cat# 97002534).

steps.title: Prepare Bead Mix
steps.instruction: In a sterile DNase/RNase-free eppendorf tube, mix 10 µL of RNA binding beads and 10 µL of lysis/binding enhancer (total 20 µL) per sample.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the beads before mixing.
Vortex the mixture after preparation.
Vortex again immediately before use.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis/Binding Solution
steps.instruction: Add a total of 350 μL Lysis/Binding solution to each sample in a Deep Well (DW) plate labeled 'Sample'.

substeps.instruction: Add 175 μL Lysis/Binding solution to samples and pipette up and down.
Transfer to the DW 'Sample' plate.
Add another 175 μL Lysis/Binding solution to the original sample tubes to collect remaining blood, mix, and transfer to the DW 'Sample' plate.

steps.title: Set Up KingFisher Instrument
steps.instruction: Connect the Kingfisher instrument to the computer via USB cable and select the 'RNA10uLMouseBlood.bdz' protocol in the BindIt software.

substeps.instruction: Click the 'start' (green arrow) button in the software.

steps.title: Load Plates into Machine
steps.instruction: Load plates as prompted by the machine, ensuring the A1 well aligns with the marked corner of the turntable.

substeps.instruction: Press the 'start' button on the instrument after loading each plate to progress to the next.

steps.title: Execute Machine Run
steps.instruction: Start the run and add reagents at the dispense steps (grey cells in machine protocol) as prompted by the instrument.

substeps.instruction: Note that the first dispense step occurs roughly 2 minutes after start-time.
Vortex beads immediately before adding them.

steps.title: Post-Run Processing
steps.instruction: Remove plates when prompted and export/save the run details as a PDF. Switch off the machine.

steps.title: Seal and Store RNA Extracts
steps.instruction: Verify liquid is present in the elution plate. Seal the elution plate with freezer-suitable plastic film (not optical qPCR film) and label carefully.

substeps.instruction: Freeze at -20°C (short term) or -70°C (long term), or use immediately for cDNA+qPCR.

steps.title: Clean Up
steps.instruction: Discard all plates except the elution plate. If reusing plates, use different clean wells and remove liquids from used wells before storage.

steps.title: Prepare DNase Treatment Mix
steps.instruction: In a sterile DNase/RNase-free eppendorf tube, mix 49 µL Turbo DNase buffer and 1 µL Turbo DNase enzyme per sample.

substeps.instruction: Mix the buffer well before use.
Mix the final solution thoroughly with a pipette.
Leave at room temperature until needed.

steps.title: Prepare RQ1 Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the RQ1 reaction mix and combine with RNA extract.

substeps.instruction: Thaw RQ1 RNase-Free DNase kit and frozen samples on ice.
Vortex RQ1 buffer once defrosted.
Mix 2 µL RQ1 10x reaction buffer and 4 µL RQ1 enzyme per sample.
Aliquot 6 µL of this mix per sample into PCR tubes/plate.
Add 14 µL of RNA extract to each tube/well (total volume 20 µL).
Mix gently and seal tubes/plate.

steps.title: Perform DNase Digestion
steps.instruction: Process the samples in a PCR machine using the specified temperature cycles.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Briefly centrifuge to spin down contents.
Add 2 µL RQ1 stop solution to each sample.
Incubate at 65°C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Final Cooling and Storage
steps.instruction: Cool samples to 4°C for 5 minutes before cDNA production, or store at -20°C (short term) or -70°C (long term).
